title: Funeral service held for Pte. Goulding, killed in CFB Wainwright tragedy

 Global News Mon, November 9, 2026 at 1:25 a.m. UTC Add Yahoo as a preferred source to see more of our stories on Google. A 23-year-old Canadian soldier is being remembered as a fearless, adventurous young man who found a sense of belonging in the Canadian Armed Forces. Pte. Aidan Goulding was laid to rest in Vancouver on Sunday, with full military honours. He was one of four soldiers who died last month in a fast-moving fire at Canadian Forces Base Wainwright. Sarah MacDonald reports.
